headline: Ella Langley CHOOSES 🐎 TEXAS 🍆 to SMASH 💥 Records 🏆
text:
ELLA 🧑‍🎤 LANGLEY'S 🍑 Choosin' 🏹 Texas 🤠 has RACKED 🛠️ up its 23rd 🥈 week 📅 at the US 🇺🇸 charts 📊 breaking 💔 the record 🏅 set 🛠️ by Mariah 🎤 Carey 🎄!! The country 🐄 smash 💥 racks 🛠️ up its 23rd 🥈 week 📅 in the US 🇺🇸 charts 📊 overtaking 🎉 Mariah 🎤 Carey's 🎄 All I Want for Christmas Is You 🎁 to become the longest-running 🏃‍♀️ number one single 🎵 in US 🇺🇸 chart 📈 history 📖!! Released 🍼 last October 🎃 the bittersweet 😢 song 🎶 details 📝 Langley's suspicions 🕵️ that her boyfriend 💑 is about to run 🏃 off with another woman 👩!! It topped ⬆️ the US 🇺🇸 Billboard 📊 chart 📈 for the first time in February ❄️ and has now spent 23 🥈 weeks 📅 at number one 🥇 with the immovability 🪨 of both songs 🎵 raising questions ❓ about stagnation 🛑 in the charts 📊 and whether streaming services 📱 are doing enough to promote new music 🎶!!

Choosin' 🏹 Texas 🤠 also rose 🌹 to pole position 🏁 on the UK 🇬🇧 singles chart 📈 at the start of September 🍂 where it replaced 🔄 Sam Fender 🧔 and Olivia Dean 👩‍🎤's Rein Me In ⛓️!! That song 🎵 had also spent 23 🥈 weeks 📅 at number one 🥇 making it the UK's 🇬🇧 longest-running 🏃‍♀️ chart-topper 🏆!! The immovability 🪨 of both songs 🎵 has raised questions ❓ about stagnation 🛑 in the charts 📊 and whether streaming services 📱 are doing enough to promote new music 🎶 bro it's cooked 🍳!! Langley 🧑‍🎤 won seven 🏆 trophies 🏆 at this year's Academy 🏛️ of Country Music Awards 🐄 with her song 🎵 written ✍️ at a writing retreat 🏕️ in 2024 📅 with assistance 🤝 from country star ⭐ Miranda Lambert 🤠!!

Unexpectedly 😲 it started with a discussion 🗣️ about a pet kangaroo 🦘 Lambert 🤠 had once owned 🏡!! She told 📖 me the story 📖 about how she got pulled over 🚔 by the police 👮 with a kangaroo 🦘 in the passenger seat 🪑 and a dog 🐶 in the back!! The officer 👮 was so surprised 😲 that she didn't issue a ticket 🎟️!! Langley 🧑‍🎤 responded to Lambert 🤠 saying the cop 👮 must have known she was from Texas 🤠 given the chaos 🌪️ unfolding in the car 🚗!! That prompted the lyric 📜 "She's from Texas 🤠 I can tell" 👀 over the next 30 ⏰ minutes ⏱️ the writers ✍️ who also included Luke Dick 🧔 and Joybeth Taylor 👩 cooked 🍳 up a story 📖 about a woman 👩 in Tennessee 🏔️ who realises her partner's heart 💔 still belongs to Texas 🤠 and to another girl 👧!!

First previewed 👀 on stage 🎤 in February ❄️ 2025 📅 Langley 🧑‍🎤 said she instantly knew it would become the first single 🎵 from her sophomore album 💿 Dandelion 🌼!! We loved ❤️ that song 🎵 but I don't think I could ever have imagined what's happening with it right now the singer 🧑‍🎤 told Billboard 📊 magazine 📰!! Every day 🌅 I wake up ☕ and it's doing something that I didn't even know was a goal 🥅 I could have had!! It's crazy 🤪 it's nuts 🥜 her success helped the 27-year-old 🧑‍🎤 who is actually from Alabama 🐊 sweep 🧹 the Academy 🏛️ of Country Music Awards 🐄 in May 🌷!!

She won 🏆 in all seven 🏆 categories 📂 in which she was nominated 🗳️ including female artist of the year 👑 artist songwriter of the year ✍️ and both single 🎵 and song of the year 🏅 for Choosin' 🏹 Texas 🤠!! It is now one of only two songs 🎵 to surpass 20 🥈 weeks 📅 at number one 🥇 on the US 🇺🇸 charts 📊 with the other being Mariah 🎤 Carey's perennial Christmas 🎄 smash 💥 All I Want for Christmas Is You 🎁!! But the records 🏆 for long-running hits 🎯 have been tumbling 🪨 ever since streaming 📱 became a mainstream phenomenon 🌊!! For 23 years 📅 Carey's own One Sweet Day 🍭 a duet 🎤 with Boyz II Men 👦 held the title 🏷️ notching up 16 🥈 weeks 📅 at number one 🥇!!

Daddy Yankee 🇵🇷 and Luis Fonsi 🎤's Despacito remix 🌀 featuring Justin Bieber 👦 tied the record 🏅 in 2017 📅 then Lil Nas X 🐴's Old Town Road 🐎 surpassed it the following year 📅 eventually spending 19 🥈 weeks 📅 at the top ⬆️!! All I Want for Christmas Is You 🎄 eventually overtook that thanks to its habit 🔄 of returning to the charts 📊 every December ❄️!! But critics 🧐 say that streaming services 📱 are increasingly encouraging listeners 👂 to play the same playlists 📜 of familiar songs 🎵 over and over again creating a bottleneck 🍼 that makes it harder for new music 🎶 to break through 💥!! In 2022 📅 a report 📄 by the UK's 🇬🇧 Competition and Markets Authority 🏛️ found that more than 60% 📊 of streams 📱 were of music 🎵 recorded by only the top 0.4% 🏆 of artists 🧑‍🎤!!
